description: Settings → Workflows exposes the project's default workflow configuration (read/select/clear), visually distinguishes system-default metadata from project-default state, and makes create-issue/profile-selection surfaces honor the configured project default.

tasks.title: Add project workflow-profile default-template client, hooks, and effective-default resolution in entities/settings
tasks.spec: specs/web-ui/spec.md#Settings Workflows exposes project default workflow configuration
tasks.description: Add the data-access foundation in entities/settings: API client functions for GET/PUT/DELETE on /workflow-profile/default-template, TanStack Query hooks with correct query keys and invalidation, and a centralized useEffectiveDefaultWorkflowProfile hook that resolves the effective default via project-configured → system-default precedence. Re-export from the slice index. This is the shared module consumed by both the Settings control and the consumer surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: entities/settings/api/client.ts exports getProjectDefaultWorkflowProfile (GET /workflow-profile, projects to { projectId, defaultTemplateId: string | null }), setProjectDefaultWorkflowProfile (PUT /workflow-profile/default-template, body { templateId }), and clearProjectDefaultWorkflowProfile (DELETE /workflow-profile/default-template), all using projectApiPath from shared/api/client.ts
entities/settings/api/queries.ts exports useProjectDefaultWorkflowProfile with query key ['project-workflow-profile', projectId] and enabled: !!projectId

useSetProjectDefaultWorkflowProfile and useClearProjectDefaultWorkflowProfile invalidate ['project-workflow-profile', projectId] on success, call toast.success, and call toast.error(err.message) on error

useEffectiveDefaultWorkflowProfile returns { effectiveTemplateId: string; source: 'project' | 'system' | 'none'; configuredTemplateId: string | null } resolving project-configured first, then system default (profiles.find(p => p.isDefault)?.id ?? 'mohist/default')
All new functions and hooks are re-exported from entities/settings/index.ts

Unit tests in entities/settings/api/queries.test.ts cover: effective-default resolution returns 'project' source when defaultTemplateId is set; 'system' source when unset (falls back to isDefault profile); mutation hooks trigger the correct query-key invalidation and toast calls
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes
tasks.output: entities/settings/api/client.ts and queries.ts additions + index.ts re-exports + queries.test.ts cases
tasks.notes: Follows the structural precedent of useOpencodeModel/useUpdateOpencodeModel in entities/settings. Per design Decisions 1-4. No backend change; the three endpoints already exist in ProjectRoutes.cs.

tasks.title: Implement ProjectDefaultWorkflowControl in Settings → Workflows and visually separate system-default badge
tasks.spec: specs/web-ui/spec.md#System default metadata is visually distinguished from project default state
tasks.description: Build the ProjectDefaultWorkflowControl sub-component and integrate it at the top of WorkflowProfilesSection (above the catalog), guarded by the active project. The control reads the project default, lets the user select a system template (PUT) or clear (DELETE) with readback, and restyles the static isDefault catalog badge to 'System default' so it cannot be mistaken for the project default.
acceptanceCriteria: ProjectDefaultWorkflowControl renders at the top of WorkflowProfilesSection and is guarded by currentProject (renders a 'No project selected' hint when projectId is null, mirroring the repositories/label-catalog guard in SettingsPage)
The control displays the current defaultTemplateId from useProjectDefaultWorkflowProfile; when null it shows copy explaining the project is inheriting the system default (e.g. 'mohist/default')
Selecting a system template (e.g. mohist/pr) calls useSetProjectDefaultWorkflowProfile with templateId 'mohist/pr' and the readback after invalidation displays defaultTemplateId 'mohist/pr'
A Clear action calls useClearProjectDefaultWorkflowProfile and the control returns to the unset/inheriting-system-default state
When defaultTemplateId references an id absent from the system catalog, the control shows a warning with the raw id and offers Clear

The static isDefault badge in WorkflowProfilesSection card (line ~138) and detail (line ~86) views is relabeled to 'System default' with a neutral slate/gray style, visually distinct from the project default control's accent

Web tests (colocated *.test.tsx) cover: readback of an existing project default; switching to mohist/pr via PUT; clearing via DELETE returning to inheriting state; the system-default badge is visually distinct from the project-default control
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass
tasks.output: ProjectDefaultWorkflowControl component + WorkflowProfilesSection.tsx integration + badge restyle + colocated tests
tasks.notes: Per design Decisions 5 and 6. The control must answer 'what will new issues inherit for this project?' as the primary content of the section.

tasks.title: Rewire create-issue and per-issue profile selection to honor the project default
tasks.spec: specs/web-ui/spec.md#Profile selection surfaces resolve default from project configuration
tasks.description: Replace the hardcoded workflowProfiles.find((p) => p.isDefault) default lookup in CreateIssueDialog and WorkflowProfileControl with useEffectiveDefaultWorkflowProfile().effectiveTemplateId, so both surfaces resolve the default from the project configuration first and fall back to the system default only when unset.
acceptanceCriteria: features/create-issue/ui/CreateIssueDialog.tsx (around line 225) resolves the default workflow selection from useEffectiveDefaultWorkflowProfile().effectiveTemplateId instead of workflowProfiles.find((p) => p.isDefault)
widgets/issue-workflow/ui/WorkflowProfileControl.tsx (around line 47) resolves the default from useEffectiveDefaultWorkflowProfile().effectiveTemplateId instead of the hardcoded isDefault lookup
When the project default is mohist/pr, opening the create-issue dialog without choosing a workflow resolves the default selection to mohist/pr
When the project default is unset, opening the create-issue dialog falls back to the system default profile without requiring a project default to be configured
Web tests cover both scenarios: create-issue inherits project default when configured, and create-issue falls back to system default when project default is unset
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass
tasks.output: CreateIssueDialog.tsx and WorkflowProfileControl.tsx rewired + colocated/feature tests
tasks.notes: Per design Decision 4 application. Non-destructive: affects the default suggestion only, does not retarget existing issues. No dependency on T-002 — both UI tasks consume the T-001 hook independently.
